# Burrow

**Category:** Combat  
**Aliases:** Burrow

## What it does

Attempts to clip you into a block.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/MeteorDevelopment/meteor-client/blob/e3a2e77967629d216e127b5ceecf71fb15f9d2e5/src/main/java/meteordevelopment/meteorclient/systems/modules/combat/Burrow.java).
